mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE < 4.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal income (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC for the interaction is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) in the early-cycle expansion phase indicates robust manufacturing activity, correlating with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises in early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in early-cycle is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals potential central bank rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annual, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 2.5% is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real GDP level (GDPC1) from the previous quarter indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 shows positive quarterly growth, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer spending power and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises above 0.5% MoM and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary tightening cycle indicates policy normalization, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity attractiveness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises in a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is negative.
